scenicChapters.title: Pacific Coast to Santa Barbara fuel gate → Pacific Coast to Santa Barb
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 59 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

title: Angeles Crest Highway
aliases: Los Angeles / Southern California edge start
slogan: A 285 km loop out of Angeles Crest Highway
story: A proper escape from Los Angeles with roads worth waking up for. This road trip is shaped as a ride, not as a shortcut: leave the start cleanly, use the first checkpoint for fuel and weather discipline, then let the middle 98 km be the part you remember. The best part sits around Angeles Crest Highway scenic road, Angeles Crest Highway high point, Angeles Crest Highway photo pull-off, while Angeles Crest Highway fuel gate and Angeles Crest Highway food stop keep the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel hunt. Check the selected map before departure: scenic sections, transfer sections, speed/control reminders, risk points and the GPX checkpoint order are deliberately visible so the route is understandable before the engine starts. Ride it early if the area is popular, keep the photo stops legal, and shorten the route if weather, daylight or energy stops agreeing with the plan.
